_archive: V2 archived to state-v2-archive.json. V4.0-V4.2 build tasks (22 tasks) archived to state-v42-archive.json. Code quality + repo audit archived this session.
vision: Build a plan-driven bug attribution agent with internal governance. The system separates concerns into three pipelines: (1) Input Pipeline — deterministic extraction and candidate retrieval at zero LLM cost; (2) Agent Pipeline — LLM plans, examines, and attributes within an InvestigationBrief, governed by an investigation harness with rules and skills; (3) Evaluation Pipeline — oracle scores output. The agent receives a CandidateSet (not raw repo access), operates within completion criteria (not just budget), produces structured InvestigationTraces for learning, and improves over time via skills derived from traces. Evaluated via Hit@k, MRR, D3, D6, and Retrieval Recall against ApacheJIT ground truth.
direction: V4.2 PROVEN at Hit@5=0.600 (baseline). P24 quick wins: triage expansion REVERTED (dilutes LLM attention), --first-parent removal KEPT (structurally correct, no regression). Current effective Hit@5=0.550-0.600 (LLM variance). Next phase: CAUSAL TRACING. Phase 0 (bug localization + targeted blame via reverse SZZ) addresses the 8 structural misses. Validated by diagnostic spike (P25) before full build (P26). Embedding retrieval (P27) is fallback if Phase 0 insufficient.

invariants.temporal_bound: Temporal bound (COMMIT_B~1) constrains the ENTIRE system — input pipeline retrieval and agent tools. In eval mode, bound comes from fix_hash.
invariants.llm_reasons_scripts_retrieve: Scripts own retrieval (candidate set assembly) and evidence verification. LLM owns planning, examination reasoning, and attribution.
invariants.agent_is_governed: The investigation harness governs the LLM. The harness manages state, transitions, and completion criteria.
invariants.observable_by_design: Every investigation produces a structured InvestigationTrace. Traces are the substrate for skill emergence.
invariants.ground_truth: GroundTruthGraph provides bug_hash from commit_links.csv. SZZ-based labeling has known noise — Hit@5 is primary metric, not Hit@1.

tasks.name: Diagnostic: Phase 0 bug localization feasibility on 8 misses
tasks.scope: For each of the 8 remaining misses: (1) Stack trace fast path — parse (file:line) from JIRA stack traces, resolve in repo at fix_hash~1, git blame those lines, check if blame SHA matches any GT bug_hash. (2) LLM localization — for cases without stack traces, manually identify the likely buggy code area from JIRA + code reading, blame it, check. Output: table with columns [case, has_stack_trace, localized_file, localized_lines, blame_sha, gt_match, notes]. Gate: if blame yields GT for 5+ of 8 cases → build Phase 0 module (P26). If <5 → add embedding retrieval as primary strategy instead.
tasks.note: This is the critical experiment. The hypothesis (reverse SZZ via JIRA-guided localization) is strong but untested. The diagnostic costs ~1 hour and determines the entire next phase.

tasks.name: Phase 0: bug localization + targeted blame retrieval strategy
tasks.scope: New pipeline phase before retrieval. Two paths: (A) Stack trace fast path — regex parses Java stack traces from JIRA description, extracts (file:line) pairs, resolves files via git ls-tree at fix_hash~1, blames those exact lines. Zero LLM cost. (B) LLM localization fallback — when no stack trace, cheap LLM (nano/haiku) reads JIRA description + top extracted files' source code at fix_hash~1, returns structured bug locations [{file, line_start, line_end, reason}]. Blame those lines. Both paths produce StrategyHit objects with strategy='localization_blame' that merge into the existing candidate set via merge_hits(). Additive — if Phase 0 produces nothing, existing pipeline runs unchanged. Touch: new module src/commit_investigator/localization/, changes to retriever.py (add strategy), problem_extractor.py (stack trace parser).
tasks.note: CONDITIONAL: only build if P25 diagnostic shows 5+ rescues. Architecture: Phase 0 sits between extraction and retrieval. It uses the LLM for code understanding (not search), which is a refinement of the 'LLM reasons, scripts retrieve' invariant — the LLM localizes the bug, scripts execute blame.

tasks.name: Embedding retrieval: bi-encoder ANN on commit message corpus
tasks.scope: New retrieval strategy. Pre-compute embeddings of all commit messages (+ files_changed list) per repo using a local embedding model (nomic-embed-text or all-MiniLM-L6-v2). At retrieval time, embed JIRA title+description, find top-50 nearest commits by cosine similarity. Add as 'embedding' strategy hits in merge_hits(). Index stored per-repo under data/embedding_indexes/. One-time build cost (~30-60s per repo). Zero per-query LLM cost. Touch: new module src/commit_investigator/retrieval/embedding_strategy.py, changes to retriever.py.
tasks.note: DECISION GATE: only build if Phase 0 alone doesn't achieve Hit@5 ≥ 0.800 on n=20 eval. If Phase 0 reaches 0.850+, embeddings are likely unnecessary. Evaluate after Phase 0 n=20 eval.
